title: evmhot deposit_swept (token deposit)
description: The deposit_swept event evmhot sends for a token deposit, once every sweep that settles it has succeeded and been checked on its receipt. Version 1.0.0. Producer: evmhot (SPEC REQ-WH-3, REQ-WH-4, REQ-WH-9, REQ-SW-10, amendments 0003 and 0004). Receivers key on (id, event); consumers that register sweeps key each sweeps[] entry on (chain, sweep_block_hash, sweep_log_index). Consumers MUST ignore fields they don't know: later minor versions add optional fields.

id.description: <chain>:<inbound tx hash>:<inbound block-level log index>. Stable for the deposit.

chain.description: Network name from evmhot's configuration, e.g. polygon, base.

registration_id.description: The id the client registered the deposit address under.

from_address.description: The inbound transfer's sender (the Transfer log's from). null only for deposits recorded before evmhot stored senders; such deposits never reach a per_transfer or per_sender target.

amount.description: The inbound amount, in the token's minor units.

token_symbol.description: Metadata only; "UNKNOWN" when symbol() could not be read. Admission is by token_address.

sweep_tx_hash.description: Equal to sweeps[0].sweep_tx_hash; kept for older clients.

sweeps.description: One entry per sweep that settled the deposit: one, or several when the amount was split by the target's max. Ordered by part. Under per_transfer, every entry is for this deposit alone.

sweep_log_index.description: Block-level logIndex of the Transfer into the target, from the receipt.

sweep_target.description: The address the Transfer went to. null only for sweeps recorded before targets were stored.

atoms.description: Decimal integer string in the token's minor units.
